question: What is your refund policy?
answer: You can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to create a new password.

question: Do you offer student discounts?
answer: Yes, students with a valid .edu email address get 20% off any annual plan. Apply the discount at checkout by verifying your student status.

question: How can I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription. Your plan will remain active until the end of the current billing cycle.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Yes, we use industry-standard 256-bit SSL encryption and never store your full card number on our servers. All payments are processed through PCI-compliant providers.

question: Can I use the product on multiple devices?
answer: Yes, your account can be logged into up to 3 devices simultaneously on the Pro plan, and unlimited devices on the Business plan.

question: What happens if I exceed my storage limit?
answer: You'll receive an email warning when you reach 90% of your storage limit. If you exceed it, uploads will be paused until you free up space or upgrade your plan.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, our app is available for free on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, with full feature parity to the desktop version.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our support team via live chat in the app, or by emailing support@example.com. Average response time is under 2 hours during business days.

question: Can I export my data?
answer: Yes, go to Settings > Data Export to download all your data as a CSV or JSON file at any time, even after cancelling your subscription.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans. Cryptocurrency payments are not currently supported.

question: Is there a free trial available?
answer: Yes, all new accounts get a 14-day free trial with full access to Pro features. No credit card is required to start the trial.

question: How do I invite team members?
answer: Go to Team Settings > Invite Members and enter their email addresses. They'll receive an invitation link to join your workspace.

question: What happens to my data if I delete my account?
answer: All your data is permanently deleted within 30 days of account deletion. You can request immediate deletion by contacting support.

question: Do you offer discounts for non-profits?
answer: Yes, registered non-profit organizations receive a 30% discount on all annual plans. Submit your non-profit documentation to support to apply.

question: Can I change my billing cycle from monthly to annual?
answer: Yes, go to Account Settings > Billing and select 'Switch to Annual'. You'll be prorated for the remainder of your current billing period.

question: What browsers are supported?
answer: We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and follow the setup instructions using an authenticator app like Google Authenticator.

question: Can I downgrade my plan at any time?
answer: Yes, you can downgrade at any time from Account Settings > Billing. The change takes effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

question: Do you provide API access?
answer: Yes, API access is available on the Business plan and above. You can generate API keys from Settings > Developer > API Keys.
